rules.name: Bocage Terrain
rules.description:
Bocage is hard cover, an obstacle for infantry, and impassible to non-tracked vehicles. Tracked vehicles must take a full Top Speed order to move to the other side of the bocage.

Vehicles with a dozer blade or other hedge cutter device treat bocage as dangerous terrain and cut it down so that it acts as a normal hedge. Demolition charges can destroy up to 5" of bocage per charge used.

rules.name: Aircraft Table
rules.description:
1	P-51 Mustang
2-5	P-47 Thunderbolt
6	Player's Choice (still roll for armaments)

You may always choose an aircraft from lower on the table than your roll.  You must still roll for armament.
